_comment: Shown in the update prompts. Edit before each release. minVersion: apps older than this must update before they continue (use for security fixes); leave it at an old version normally.
notes: A fresh premium look: gradients, smooth animations, 3D cards and sliding tabs across the app
New Semesters view: swipe through your 12 semesters next to EWU's official course plan
See which official courses are done, this semester, planned or still to catch up
Drop a course: see today's refund, credit change and graduation effect, with undo
Courses you drop stay dropped after a portal sync; email your advisor in one tap
